Holidays roll to the next occurrence automatically.
ONLY FOR “🎂 BIRTHDAY”
Type the month and day as MM/DD — for example 03/21 for March 21st. The year is automatic.
ONLY FOR “📅 CUSTOM DATE”
Date format: MM/DD/YYYY (e.g. 12/31/2026). Time is optional — use 9:00 PM or 24-hour 21:00. Leave time blank to count to midnight.
